description:
Custom Rich Presence (playing status) manager for Discord. Features run on startup and minimizing to tray.


- Fixed a possible crash when resetting corrupted settings. 
- You can now change ID without disconnecting first, CustomRP will reconnect automatically on ID change.
- The maximum date you can set for a timestamp is now 16th November 5128 9:46:39am UTC (99999999999 in unix seconds) because anything after that results in a glitchy behavior with the time display.
